reason: The plugin is primarily a user-facing plugin discovery interface: it adds a catalog surface in the DeepSeek Harness web UI and shows repositories tagged `dsh-plugin` with copyable install commands, with GitHub search + mirror + fallback paths and explicit documentation-only sections for skills and MCP guidance.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 扩展插件，在侧边栏/面板内提供 `dsh-plugin` GitHub 插件目录浏览入口，并展示可供复制的插件安装命令。
summaries.en: This DeepSeek Harness web plugin adds in-app views in the sidebar/shell to browse `dsh-plugin` GitHub repositories and display copyable install commands for each plugin.

capabilities: Displays a catalog UI in DeepSeek Harness shell/sidebar slots for browsing `dsh-plugin` repositories
Performs/relies on repository discovery from GitHub topic-based data sources (and a mirror/fallback list)
Provides copyable plugin install command text for each listed plugin

reasons.code: Repository metadata and README describe an extension center with sidebar nav and GitHub plugin catalog functionality.
README states plugin cards copy `dsh plugin --profile web add github:owner/repo` and explicitly notes install is not executed in-browser.
Package manifest declares a web client bundle injecting locale/layout/sidebar UI modules, indicating intended in-app panel/shell integration.
